title: Diffusion & Generative Vision
blurb: The theory that made image generation work, then the engineering that made it fast enough to ship.

anchors.note: The paper that made diffusion competitive. A simple noise-prediction objective, and suddenly it trains.
Unifies score matching and diffusion as one SDE. The theory the rest of the field is written in.
Drops the separate classifier and gets better control from the model itself. Every image model uses this.
Run diffusion in a compressed latent space instead of pixels. This is what made Stable Diffusion possible.
Shows a large frozen text encoder matters more than a bigger image model.
Replaces the U-Net with a transformer and shows it scales predictably. The backbone of current video models.
Adds spatial conditioning to a frozen model without destroying it. Turned generation into something directable.
The engineering write-up: what actually had to change to make latent diffusion production-grade.
